# Repository Instructions

- Do not use Angular CLI or Angular CLI MCP tools for this repository, including `mcp_angular-cli-s_*` tools, Angular CLI project discovery, Angular CLI best-practices tools, or Angular CLI target runners.
- Use the standard workspace tools for reading and editing files.
- Use `run_in_terminal` for builds, tests, linting, and other one-shot project commands, unless the user explicitly requests another tool.
- Do not start or modify development servers unless the user asks for that work.
